text.tspan: ElastiCache: an in-memory cache in front of the database
the cache on a miss; data can be
whenever the DB is written; never
Why: very low latency, takes read load off the DB, makes the app stateless. Cost: you must change app code.
• read replicas to scale reads, HA
• backup and restore only in serverless
• pick it for a simple, disposable cache
Security: IAM policies for the AWS API · Redis AUTH (password/token) + TLS in flight · IAM auth for Redis · Memcached: SASL · security groups.
